params.1273: Brew an attack potion to increase your combat abilities.
params.1274: Get a <col=FFFFFF>vial of water</col> and <col=FFFFFF>eye of newt</col> from <col=FFFFFF>Poletax</col>.
params.1275: If you need more guam, check if Poletax has any or get some by killing monsters.
params.1276: Click on the <col=FFFFFF>grimy guam</col> to clean it.
params.1277: Use a <col=FFFFFF>clean guam</col> on the <col=FFFFFF>vial</col> and select <col=FFFFFF>guam potion (unf)</col>.
params.1278: Use the <col=FFFFFF>eye of newt</col> on the <col=FFFFFF>guam potion</col> and select <col=FFFFFF>attack potion (3)</col>.
params.2225: All potions require a vial of water, a clean herb, and specific other ingredient. Higher Herblore levels allow you to make more powerful potions.
